title: #39 - I'M Sure To Eat The Lamb Chops
content:
#39 - I'M Sure To Eat The Lamb Chops

Chapter 39 I'm going to eat the lamb chops

[Baron: Arthur Bracken]

[Level: 5]

[Experience: 3265/4000]

[Strength: 17]

[Agility: 12]

[Intelligence: 7]

[Charm: 9]

[Skills: Iron Bones 4, Power Attack 7, Power Throw 1, Power Bow 1, Weapon Mastery 2, Shield Defense 0, Running 2, Riding 4, Horse Archery 0, Looting 0, Coaching 0, Tracking 0, Tactics 1, Guide 0, Scouting 0, Healing 0, Surgery 0, First Aid 0, Engineering 0, Persuasion 1, Prisoner Management 1, Command 3, Trading 0]

[Weapon Proficiency: One-handed Weapons 74, Two-handed Weapons 125, Pole Weapons 77, Bows 31, Crossbows 31, Throwing 31]

The experience gained from the quest to find Cyril brought him to level 5.

The attribute points gained from the upgrade continued to be added to Agility, two skill points, one for Prisoner Management and one for Running, and weapon points continued to be added to Two-handed Weapons.

After skillfully adding points, Arthur put away the panel.

His strength has reached seventeen. According to Arthur's experience, almost no ordinary person can resist his great strength.

In other words, Arthur's strength is enough to reach the level of the famous knights in Westeros.

But there may still be a gap from the Mountain, anyway, he has to keep improving.

The good news is that the training of Arthur's troops will also bring him experience, so the speed of upgrading will be faster.

It was already noon, and the group found an inn and prepared to eat.

The nine gamblers also came in with their hands tied, and the horses and ox carts were fed with grass by the store.

If a few more copper coins were given, the store would be happy to add some soybeans, wheat, corn, soybeans and other concentrated feed to the grass.

The products of the river land are so abundant that cattle and horses can eat better.

Arthur threw ten copper coins to the waiter and asked them to serve their mounts.

The waiter took it quickly and said okay, and went out to add concentrated feed later.

With his eyes that had seen all kinds of people, he could naturally tell that these were the elite soldiers of Shili City.

The horses outside were definitely not skinny horses for plowing, but fat war horses.

Such guests must be served well.

Because it was a small inn in the countryside, it could not serve whatever dishes were ordered, but had to look at the inn's menu today.

The best food was roasted lamb chops with black pepper. There were eight portions marked on the menu board, just enough for eight people.

The staple food was vermicelli with green sauce, one portion each for the gamblers and soldiers.

"Madam, eight portions of roasted lamb chops with black pepper, seventeen portions of vermicelli with green sauce."

The soldiers had a big appetite, so it was normal to order an extra portion of vermicelli.

The gamblers were captives, so they could not eat good things like roasted lamb chops. It was Arthur's kindness to give them vermicelli with green sauce.

"Okay, sir, wait a moment." The lady boss replied cheerfully.

Arthur's tall and handsome appearance shows that he is a son of a noble family. The fully armored soldiers around him further prove the judgment of the proprietress.

Originally, such noble children rarely came to her inn to rest.

However, due to the recent rumors that the king is about to hold a grand tournament for his new prime minister, and the champion prize is as high as tens of thousands of gold dragons, many wandering warriors and free riders have gone to King's Landing to try their luck.

Of course, there are also bards, female workers, and thieves and vendors who follow.

There are also many noble children, so the proprietress is not surprised.

This is why there are luxurious foods such as roast lamb chops these days. Usually, she would worry about not being able to sell out the chicken in the store, but these days she doesn't have to worry about business at all.

Of course, she selectively ignored the nine gangster-like people with their hands tied.

The affairs of the nobles are not for the common people to ask.

Even if there are strange habits, it's up to the masters, as long as it doesn't affect themselves.

"Wait, leave the black pepper grilled lamb chops for us, let them eat the noodles."

Just as the proprietress turned around, a voice came from the door of the store.

She turned around and found five or six people walking in.

The leader was wearing a thin bright yellow silk shirt and trousers, boots of the same color, and a knight's sword on his waist.

At first glance, he was a real rich noble.

Compared with the tall and handsome man who asked for lamb chops before, this one looked like his family had a higher title.

"But, sir, this lord came first." She didn't dare to agree to this person, nor did she dare to refuse openly.

Both sides were nobles, and she couldn't afford to offend anyone.

"Just serve me the grilled lamb chops, don't worry about anything else. In the riverlands, anyone who sees my purple background and silver eagle logo will choose to bow to me."

The proprietress had no choice. The nobles here were more stubborn. She had to run to Arthur who was already seated and asked:

"Sir, the adults over there want to eat grilled lamb chops. Can you please give way?"

Arthur had already noticed the man in bright yellow clothes. Seeing him so arrogant, he couldn't help but sneer:

"I came here first, and I ordered the grilled lamb chops first. How can I give way? Go tell him that I'm going to eat this grilled lamb chops."

The man in bright yellow clothes also heard what was said here, and his attitude became even tougher.

"Go tell this little noble who came from an unknown village that I, Patrick, don't care about these things. The grilled lamb chops must go into my mouth."

Both of them could hear each other's words, but they had to use the proprietress as a middleman to pass the message. This scene seemed a bit funny and childish.

Arthur was about to respond again, when Javier, who was sitting next to him, whispered to him:

"This should be Patrick Mallister, the heir of Seaside City. It is said that they are arrogant and conceited. Don't offend them."

Arthur turned his head and looked at Javier up and down, "I didn't expect you to be such a person. We are right, why are you afraid?"

He will eat this lamb chop today, and no one can help.

It is not in Arthur's character to let the proprietress pass the message.

It is meaningless to embarrass a civilian.

He turned around and stared at this young master Patrick, "You'd better not make me angry, the grilled lamb chops are ours."

As he said, he touched his sledgehammer.

If the young man didn't give in, he would give them a severe lesson.

Patrick stood up, and Arthur thought he was going to fight, so he held the sledgehammer in his hand and slowly raised it.

Unexpectedly, Patrick just opened his mouth and looked straight at Arthur's face.

This look made him very uncomfortable, but also a little familiar.

Thinking carefully, he had this feeling in the eyes of the nine gamblers.

"He looked at me but didn't say anything. What does that mean?"

Arthur didn't know what to do, so he asked the people around him.

Jules smiled greasy, "Isn't it obvious? They are in love!"

Arthur's uncle's smile made him feel goosebumps all over.

Because in the morning, Jules had this smile when he reminded him about the sheep.

This is definitely not a good thing!

Javier also said to Arthur: "You should have confidence in your appearance. This is a face that men and women can't resist."
